zoom in on: The photographer zoomed in on the bird to capture every detail of its feathers.
摄影师把镜头推近那只鸟，想拍下它羽毛的每个细节。
(be) faced with: When she was faced with such a difficult choice, she asked her parents for advice.
面临如此艰难的选择时，她向父母寻求建议。
in disbelief: He stared at the test result in disbelief, unable to believe he had finally passed.
他难以置信地盯着考试结果，不敢相信自己终于通过了。
drop into: On our way home, we dropped into a small bookshop and stayed there for an hour.
回家路上我们顺便进了一家小书店，在那里待了一个小时。
dozens of: Dozens of students gathered in the hall to listen to the famous writer's speech.
几十名学生聚集在礼堂，听那位著名作家的演讲。
now and again: Now and again I call my old teacher to tell her about my progress at school.
我不时给老师打电话，告诉她我在学校的进步。
drop in: If you are ever in our town, feel free to drop in for a cup of tea.
如果你来我们镇上，随时可以顺便来喝杯茶。
call on: We plan to call on our grandparents this weekend since we haven't seen them for months.
我们打算这周末去看望祖父母，因为好几个月没见他们了。
go on circuit: The young judge went on circuit twice a year to hear cases in small towns.
那位年轻法官每年外出巡回两次，到小镇审理案件。
curriculum vitae: Before the interview, remember to bring a printed copy of your curriculum vitae.
面试前，记得带一份打印好的简历。
build on: The company hopes to build on its early success and open offices in other cities.
公司希望在初期成功的基础上继续发展，在其他城市开设办事处。
to tell you the truth: To tell you the truth, I didn't enjoy the film at all, though everyone praised it.
说实话，尽管大家都称赞那部电影，我却一点也不喜欢。
infantile paralysis: Thanks to the vaccine, infantile paralysis has become rare in most parts of the world.
多亏了疫苗，小儿麻痹症在世界大部分地区已经很少见了。
in other words: He is too busy to take a holiday this year; in other words, we must travel alone.
他今年忙得没时间休假；换句话说，我们只能自己去旅行了。
adapt to: It took him a few weeks to adapt to the cold weather in the north.
他花了几个星期才适应北方寒冷的天气。
out of breath: She was out of breath after running to catch the last bus.
她跑着去赶末班车，累得上气不接下气。
sit around: Instead of sitting around all day, why not find something useful to do?
与其整天闲坐着，为什么不找点有用的事做呢？
in many ways: In many ways, learning a foreign language is like learning to play an instrument.
在很多方面，学一门外语就像学一种乐器。
make fun of: It is unkind to make fun of people who speak with an accent.
取笑说话带口音的人是不厚道的。
never mind: Never mind the broken cup; I have several more in the cupboard.
别担心那个打碎的杯子，橱柜里还有好几个呢。
Barry Minto: Barry Minto spent years climbing mountains to raise money for children in poor areas.
巴里·明托多年来坚持登山，为贫困地区的孩子们筹款。
Mount Kilimanjaro: They trained for months before trying to climb Mount Kilimanjaro last summer.
去年夏天尝试攀登乞力马扎罗山之前，他们训练了好几个月。
all the best: All the best in your new job, and remember to write to us sometimes.
祝你在新工作中一切顺利，记得常给我们写信。
meet with: On the way to school, we met with a heavy rain and got completely wet.
在上学路上，我们遇上了大雨，全身都湿透了。
Isaac Asimov: Isaac Asimov wrote many popular science books that made difficult ideas easy to understand.
艾萨克·阿西莫夫写了许多科普读物，把难懂的思想讲得通俗易懂。
Larry Belmont: Larry Belmont worked as an engineer before he joined the research team.
拉里·贝尔蒙特在加入研究团队之前是一名工程师。
test out: The new robot will be tested out in a hospital before it is sold.
这种新机器人上市之前将先在医院试用。
Gladys Claffern: Gladys Claffern was surprised when the robot greeted her politely at the door.
机器人在门口礼貌地向她问好时，格拉迪斯·克拉芬吃了一惊。
ring up: Ring up the hotel and ask if they have a room for two nights.
给旅馆打个电话，问问他们有没有能住两晚的房间。
turn around: The driver turned around and asked us where we wanted to get off.
司机转过身来，问我们想在哪里下车。
leave…alone: Leave the dog alone while it is eating, or it may get angry.
狗吃东西时别去惹它，否则它可能会发怒。
set aside: She sets aside an hour every evening to read English novels.
她每天晚上留出一个小时读英文小说。
in all: There were twelve of us in all, so we needed two taxis.
我们一共十二个人，所以需要两辆出租车。
be bound to: You are bound to make progress if you keep practicing every day.
如果你每天坚持练习，一定会取得进步。
master’s degree: She plans to study for a master’s degree after finishing her four-year course.
她计划读完四年课程后攻读硕士学位。
PhD=Doctor of Philosophy: It usually takes several years of research to get a PhD.
通常需要做几年的研究才能取得博士学位。
the Foundation: In the novel, the Foundation tries to save human knowledge after the empire falls.
在小说中，“基地”组织试图在帝国崩溃后保存人类的知识。
baleen whale: The baleen whale feeds on tiny sea animals by filtering seawater through its plates.
须鲸通过鲸须板过滤海水，以微小的海洋动物为食。
in the meantime: The new library will open next month; in the meantime, please use the old one.
新图书馆下个月开放；在此期间请先用旧图书馆。
Help (…) out: My neighbors often help me out by looking after my little son.
邻居们经常帮我照看小儿子，帮我渡过难关。
